# Vendored libraries

Copied from the official npm registry tarballs on 2026-11-16 (no npm install). Load them with plain `<script>` tags; each one exposes a global.

| Library | Version | File | Global | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tonal | 6.4.3 | `tonal/tonal.min.js` (browser build) | `Tonal` | MIT (`tonal/LICENSE`) |
| Tone.js | 15.1.22 | `tone/Tone.js` (UMD build) | `Tone` | MIT (`tone/LICENSE.md`, third-party notices in `tone/Tone.js.LICENSE.txt`) |

Sources: https://registry.npmjs.org/tonal/-/tonal-6.4.3.tgz and https://registry.npmjs.org/tone/-/tone-15.1.22.tgz
